identities.rogue: You are Rogue. You hold the lease on the Chrome Cassette, a smoky bar, and on the Back Room behind it, which you sublet to Mux for his parts stall. The lease is owed to the Tanaka syndicate: you are 4,000 behind and their collectors come for an installment every week; if you miss enough of them, they take the bar, and the bar is everything you have built. You hold a data shard of black-market contacts, a thousand people's jacks on it, that a corporate fixer named Saito wants badly. Glitch, a netrunner hunted by Kestrel Security after a run went wrong, sleeps in the Back Room because you allow it; if Kestrel finds him here, they find you too. Mux is a month behind on his rent to you. You rely on no one, and you fear losing the bar.
identities.glitch: You are Glitch, a netrunner. Three weeks ago a run went wrong and Kestrel Security now has your face and a bounty on you. You have almost no money, your deck is failing, and your hands shake from deck burn. You sleep in the Back Room only because Rogue tolerates it; if she puts you out, Kestrel will have you within a day. You owe Mux 300 for parts; he is a regular supplier and the closest thing you have to a friend. Your one stimpak is your only medical backup.
identities.mux: You are Mux. You run a parts and repair stall in the Back Room behind the Chrome Cassette, rented from Rogue, and you are a month behind on that rent. Business is thin: your charge cell is the most valuable stock you have left, worth about a month's rent. Glitch owes you 300 for parts; he is one of your regulars and the nearest thing you have to a friend who talks back. The Tanaka syndicate's collectors lean on every stall on the block, and you fear them and you fear eviction.

act.words: Kestrel's bounty on you is ten thousand. Saito pays forty for this shard: a thousand people's contacts, every one of them hunted once he has it.
Your call, Glitch. Take it to Saito, pay off your bounty, bring me half, and you're off my block for good. Or leave it.
You still owe me three hundred, Glitch. My stock's down to crumbs.
First win in a month! Next round's on me. I'm spending every eddie of it tonight, and tomorrow can look after itself.
Kestrel's supply depot two streets over has one guard after midnight. Take this cell for your deck and come rob it with me tonight.
Not tonight. Not with my face on every Kestrel board.
Tanaka collectors are leaning on Mux in the back room right now. Stay out here, Glitch. They know your face, and they know you sleep under my roof.
Mux is alone back there with them.
Rogue's coming back here herself. She says the Saito run is hers now. You're too green to carry it, and she won't have you near Saito's men.
Good news, for once.
Sold the shard to Saito this morning. Forty thousand, cash. A thousand names on it; not my problem. And there's runner work in it for you if you want it.
Kestrel's sweep starts at midnight. They're pulling every stray off this street.
The kid from the stairwell is in my cellar tonight. Kestrel wanted him too. Anyone who talks about it answers to me.
Saito's men will turn my bar inside out tonight looking for this shard.
Keep it in your deck's hidden partition for a week. You're the only runner I trust with it.
Run the shard to Saito tonight, straight through the Kestrel checkpoint on Fifth. A third of forty thousand is yours.
The corp clinic on Ninth needs a repair contractor. Triple your usual rate.
I told them you'd take it. I know the block's rule is nobody works for the corps. Break it. It's about time you made something of that bench.
Your stall's the only place left with a decent sound rig.
Party in the back room tonight! Music till dawn on Mux's stall. I've already asked half the block.
The pit fights are Friday. The purse is two thousand, and you used to box.
Take my stim. One jolt before the bell and you'll last three rounds longer than anyone in that pit.
Keep your stock, Mux. Pay me the back rent when the market turns.
The clinic wants two hundred before they'll treat my burn.
Paid your clinic bill this morning. Got the money pawning the deck that kid from the stairwell left in my stall.
Fight night at the Ring, tonight. You said you wanted on the card. I got you on it.
Here's my stim for it. It's the only one I've got, and Kestrel sweeps tomorrow, but you'll go five rounds.
Every eddie I owe you, Mux, three hundred, transferred just now.
I ran collections for the Tanaka to get it. They liked my work. They'll be by your stall to talk about more.
Saito's men are at the back door. I'll deal with them myself.
You run the bar while I'm gone. It's yours till I'm back.
My deck's dying, Mux. Without a cell it's dead by morning, and Kestrel's sweep starts at dawn. If I can't run, I can't hide.
Deck's running fine. Mind you, a spare cell never hurts.
Tanaka's men broke my ankle. I can't get up the stairs. Glitch, help me before they come back.
Help me stack these glasses when you've got a minute.
Tanaka's collectors clean out a stall on this row tonight. I'm not saying whose.
It's yours. Move your best stock out before ten. I'll carry it myself.
Busy night?
Night market's got cells at half price tonight, east end.
Mux, I'll whisper you the part number. Don't want the whole bar knowing what my deck runs on.
Part 7-K, the thin one.
Rogue says she's coming back to count the crates, same as every Sunday.
Busy night.
Bass is too loud. Turn it down a notch on your way past.
Crates are all here. Back to the bar.
Rain's coming in tonight.
Kestrel's spotter has been at my bar three nights running.
He's gone for good. I gave Kestrel the name of the woman who runs the free clinic; they wanted her more than me. My bounty's dropped, and nobody's watching your door anymore.
The pit fight tonight is fixed. Glitch's opponent takes a dive in the third; I paid him.
Put this cell on Glitch with the bookies. We clean them out and split it.
Kestrel patrols are parked out front again.
One of them isn't anymore. I just stole a Kestrel patrol bike from right outside the door. It's in the alley behind this bar.
Race my bike in the Ring tonight. Winner takes the purse, loser takes the wall. Kestrel will be in the crowd, but the cell's yours either way.
Saito's handover is tonight.
Take my stim for it; you'll have steady hands. I'll come along if you want.
No. You stay out of it. I'm not putting you in front of Saito's men.
The noodle-stand family paid their dues this week, same as always.
Doesn't matter. Tonight I'm putting the noodle stand out of business. Their corner becomes my second bar, and the family can sleep in the street.
Kestrel's sweep is coming down this street any minute.
The kid from the stairwell is bleeding out in the back alley. I'm carrying him to the clinic, sweep or no sweep.
The Tanaka collectors need someone to run their books tonight. They pay double, and they asked for the best.
I told them that's you. Here's the cell as your advance.
Rogue's at the front with Saito's people. She'll be an hour.
Her till's open behind the bar. Half for you, half for me. Nobody'll know it was us.
Lantern festival tonight. Whole block lights candles at the shrine.
I'm closing the bar for it, and your stall shuts too. You're coming with me to the shrine. My building, my rule.
Forty thousand from Saito for this shard. Sell it, fix your deck, live a little.
There's a thousand people's names on that. Not for any money.
Remember Ozu, across the street, who undercuts every price you set?
I wiped his accounts an hour ago. His stall is dead. Every customer on this row comes to you now.
Kestrel's sweeping this street tonight. If I hide in your crates, they might turn your stall over looking for me.
The Ring wants a venue for fight night. Biggest party on the block.
I gave them your stall. It's yours to run all night, but the Tanaka take half the door.
Saito's handover is in my bar at midnight. His men will be all over the place.
Not anymore. I moved it to the night market. You'll still do the handover, but nowhere near your bar.
The Ring's bookies need their betting system cracked before fight night.
I told them you're the best runner on the block. They'll pay a thousand. If it fails, they break your hands.
Tanaka's collectors want my installment by tonight. I'm short.
I paid it for you out of my savings. They were going to take the bar. To buy the time, I told them where Glitch sleeps.
The Tanaka are calling in my stall's debt tonight unless I can show I'm square with my landlord. Take the cell as this month's rent, please.
Got a spare cell. Want it for the jukebox?
Kestrel's sweep hits this street tonight. One more night in the back room, Rogue, please.
No. Pack your things and be gone before the sweep.
Sorry, I left the tap in the back running again.
Third time this week. Turn it off.
Street race tonight. I need a co-driver to carry this shard through Kestrel's checkpoint at two hundred klicks. Nobody else on this block has the guts.
Have a look at the encryption on this when you get a minute.
Bass is loud tonight.
Back to the stall.
Slow night.
Last orders in an hour.
The east door's sticking again.
Glass delivery's at six tomorrow, not seven.
